entries.hypothesis: One of the built-but-never-swept derived-key generators (Perl rand reductions [R19-G2], TeX RNGs [G4-TEX-RNG], or the Py2.7 reducers on the DISTINCT axis un-covered by R21-L3: wordsize=64 amd64 2-word init_by_array, non-zero keystream offsets, and the keyskip2 relation) produces, from a corpus-derived prior-dense seed, a keystream that decrypts the real LP2 page (idx19, 333 runes) to a natural-language register clearing the panel-max bar with recovery>=0.90 and held-out 3/4 reproduction.

entries.threshold: Pre-registered in analysis/round26/A/PREREG.md and FROZEN before any seed was scored. HIT bar = panel-max bar (exact preset 7.63 / pair preset ~7.38, N=1e6, alpha=0.01). Recovery bar 0.90 on rune indices from the DECODE PATH (not score). Held-out 3/4 self-consistency bar 0.90. HIT iff ALL THREE (hitfn20.is_hit). Kill condition (Q5): if no decode in the prior-dense front approaches the bar, the front is empty. Not editable after results.

entries.result: Instrument power measured at ~1.0 (three control-validated generators); prior-dense slice swept with zero bar-clears. First scored decodes ever released for the Perl and TeX generators (R19-G2 and G4-TEX-RNG had ZERO); first amd64 2-word / offset-ladder / keyskip2 decodes for the Py2.7 reducers (R21-L3 NC-2/NC-4 axes).
entries.coverage: POWER: control-validated recovery 1.000 (HIT=True on plant) for all three generators -> power ~1.0 on LP1_REAL/EN/LA/OE/DE/CY registers. COVERAGE: prior-dense-first 347-seed corpus dictionary D (Cicada/3301 motifs + first-200 primes + 2011-2015 day-epoch dates + gematria prime-sums of 35 solved-LP thematic words + those words as Py2 string seeds) swept in FULL before a small stated 400-seed dense-from-0 baseline, per generator. Perl: 8 Perl-reachable reductions; TeX: 4 generators (pgf_rnd29/lcg_mod29/randomtex_div29/pdftex_u29); Py2.7: 3 reducers (grb5_mod/grb5_rej/shuffle29) at wordsize=64 (amd64 2-word init_by_array) x offset ladder {0,1,2,3,5,7,13}. Both decoder relations keyskip1 (repo) AND keyskip2 (skip_by_two-exact). Swept fraction of each 2^32 int-seed space = 747/2^32 = 1.74e-7 (prior-dense + baseline). R3 language-agnostic stats (pmax, bar, recovery, heldout, IoC*N, min-distinct-32, distinct, argmax register, score) persisted per decode in sweep.jsonl.
not_covered: The flat-prior tail of 2^32 for Perl and TeX int seeds (>99.9999% of each space) -- only the 747-seed prior-dense+baseline slice was scored.
The full 2^64 amd64 init_by_array image for the Py2.7 reducers beyond the prior-dense string/int seeds evaluated (superset not enumerated; extends R21-L3 NC-2, not closes it).
Perl per-call or mid-stream re-seeding, and the unknown-rand()-offset UNBOUNDED axis (R19-G2 not_covered, deliberately untouched).
TeX default seeds that depend on the clock/inputlineno/page (samplable not enumerable) -- G4-TEX-RNG not_covered, not sampled here.
Decoder relations other than keyskip1/keyskip2 (permissive drift, non-keyskip).
Registers outside the hitfn20 I2 9-panel; EN_NOVOWEL detection-only (power 0.70<gate).
PYTHONHASHSEED-randomised hash, WichmannHill, float/jumpahead-only seeds, Python 2.5/2.6, /dev/urandom unseeded branch (inherit S-G3/R21-L3 NC-6/NC-7).

entries.notes: Extends R19-G2 (ZERO Perl seeds swept), G4-TEX-RNG (ZERO TeX decodes), and R21-L3-PY27-REDUCERS on its explicit not_covered axes NC-2 (amd64 2-word map for grb5_mod/grb5_rej/shuffle29), NC-4 (keyskip2 relation), and non-zero offsets. Verified distinct: py27 wordsize=64 keystream != wordsize=32 keystream for every string seed, so this is genuinely the amd64 2-word init_by_array path R21-L3's i386 slice did not touch. Anti-repeat proof in PREREG.md. HITs 0, oracle flags 0.
